description: If a substitution unifies a finite family of actual relation atoms, each pair has the same relation symbol and arity; simultaneous substitution changes neither part of the relation head.
signature:
Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.atom_unifier_heads.{u, v, w} {L : FirstOrder.Language} {α : Type w}
  (A : Finset (Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.HerbrandModels.Atom L ℕ)) (σ : ℕ → L.Term α)
  (h : Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.AtomUnifies σ A) :
  Lemmatheca.MathematicalLogic.FirstOrderResolution.HeadCompatible A
